summary.text: Destiny Song is Feng Jiu Ge's immortal killer move. He first uses it in a rush to stop farewell friend wind.

claims.text: At Infallible blessed land the singing voice is illusory and deep, filled with conflict; everyone on the field is engrossed until the song cuts off and they wake. Chi Qu You calls it terrifying for holding them without resistance. Feng Jiu Ge walks out of the formation in a red and white robe. Chen Yi is left with body and head; Wu Yong’s farewell friend wind is rank eight, and Destiny Song uses Fate Armor as the core and is also rank eight. Inside the formation Feng Jiu Ge spits blood: the song is not even half finished, and using it this time leaves him heavily injured. Watching from Heavenly Court, Fairy Zi Wei had treated Chen Yi’s death as certain unless farewell friend wind was defended against beforehand; she now ranks this with Assimilation Wind Song as Feng Jiu Ge writing history again.

During his rank eight tribulation he takes inspiration from The Legends of Ren Zu: heaven and earth have fate, luck path later leaves room for change, and Destiny Song will portray that brilliance, the certainty and uncertainty of heaven and earth, and the paths of all life.

After the Lang Ya defeat he stations at Embroidered Tower to take a trace of transformation from Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s three bloody skins, reading that transformation as the change of destiny. When the comprehension peaks, he names Destiny Song as his next song.

In the River of Time, aboard Present and Past Pavilion, he has been comprehending Destiny Song all along. This life’s Lang Ya defeat and Chen Yi’s karma relocation give him the inspiration earlier than the previous life, and watching past and present lives from the pavilion helps the work. The song is sixty percent complete, ten percent higher than during the Central Continent fate battle in the previous life.
In that previous life he used the incomplete Destiny Song to save Chen Yi’s life.

It already depicts the destiny of living beings, but not the destiny of venerables; Reckless Savage’s blood skins in Heavenly Court had felt incomprehensible, and he hopes the stone lotus island will push the creation further.

At eighty percent complete he finds that rank eight fate armor Immortal Gu cannot shoulder the grand and vast Destiny Song, and that he needs another luck path Immortal Gu as the core. He asks Qin Ding Ling for responsive luck Immortal Gu; she hands it over and gives it to him. He says this Gu is not enough and that he will need to head to the River of Time to view past and present and the paths of all lives.

At Hairy Foot Mountain he sings the finished move: Southern Border immortals weaken and grow dispirited, while Heavenly Court’s side feels free, recovers, and picks up in condition. The song distinguishes allies from enemies, which the previous life’s Destiny Song could never do. Focused on Di Zang Sheng, it returns the beast to the helplessness of Hidden Dragon Cave and slows the charge; Feng Jiu Ge names it his personal creation, just completed. Destiny Song can bring out the lows and highs of the destiny of all living beings. “Feng Jiu Ge’s ninth song, sound path rank eight immortal killer move, Destiny Song!” Zhan Bu Du says he created the complete Destiny Song. Fairy Zi Wei treats this one move as raising Feng Jiu Ge’s strength to the peak, among the strongest people in the world.

In Heavenly Court the song shrouds Fang Yuan throughout, cycling strong and weak, and triggers counterattacks from Reverse Flow Protection Seal. The profundities of the song weaken him even with that seal active, but the weakening is much smaller, and the same song amplifies Duke Long while it weakens Fang Yuan.

Fate Vanquish with Fate Gu as the core has no effect on Fang Yuan, but rank eight Destiny Song is of an even higher plane: it includes fate and also contains luck, so luck is effective against him. The song greatly weakens him, almost offsetting Heroes Among People. Duke Long cannot enjoy that amplification, yet Destiny Song is one of the methods empowering him.

When Feng Jiu Ge sings again, Heavenly Court’s immortals are not powered up; the three regions’ Gu Immortals gain the boost instead. Duke Long and Qin Ding Ling treat the act as betrayal. He does not stop singing, and at that moment he joins Fang Yuan and the three regions’ allied forces.

On the stone lotus island, Red Lotus Demon Venerable’s will has an incomplete destiny Gu recipe created according to the Destiny Song Feng Jiu Ge will create, of the same origin as that song. It cannot give him the complete song directly, because Fate Gu is not destroyed completely yet and will not allow this; the will converts the method into a rank nine destiny Gu recipe so he will comprehend Destiny Song in its initial form. The will says that for the following thousand years he will modify Destiny Song many times, that the last modification will let the move grow by extracting destiny from Gu Immortals it hits, and that as long as Fate Gu exists the song will be suppressed and sealed. On the battlefield he understands that he did not create a fate song: Destiny Song is the most honest thought in his inner heart. The song can raise Heavenly Court Gu Immortals and weaken enemies, but he is singing to understand his own feelings. He reads Fang Yuan and Red Lotus’s scheme as knowing his nature and not trying to convince him, instead using his own voice to convince himself.
During a later stretch when he goes missing, he cultivates Destiny Song and makes a lot of progress.
